data.name: Dawouss
data.gender_notes: Dawouss is used as a male name in Islamic naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: One who follows the right path and guides others to do the same. Derived from the Arabic root 'da'wa' which means 'to call, to invite'. In Islamic tradition, Dawouss is a title given to scholars and teachers who guide and educate others in the path of truth and righteousness. The name Dawouss carries the meaning “Follower of the Right Path” and is chosen by families in Islamic traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Arabic tradition and is also used in Arabic, Urdu, Persian. Parents who choose Dawouss usually hope their child will grow to embody follower of the right path and live with faith, good character and purpose.

data.etymology: Dawouss belongs to the Arabic linguistic tradition and is used in Islamic naming. Its recorded meaning is “Follower of the Right Path.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Dawouss total 3, giving a life-path number of 3. Number 3 is linked with Jupiter and with the qualities of creativity, expression and optimism.
